milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu's spirit fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to access

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu shatters into 100 Essence upon defeat, collected via Dream Nail

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; corpse can be Dream Nailed for dialogue

milestones.name: Enter Queen's Station
milestones.note: Run-down Stag Station connecting Fungal Wastes and Fog Canyon

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Mushroom-themed area; inhabitants include Shrumal Ogres, Funglings, Fungoons, Sporg; characters include Bretta, Cloth, Cornifer, Hornet, Leg Eater, Mister Mushroom

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Home of the Mantis Lords and Mantis Tribe; located within or bordering Fungal Wastes
zones.note: Elder Hu attacked the Mantises here; Whispering Root near Mantis Village yields 18 Essence

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Elder Hu's memorial is located above the gates to this city
zones.note: Elder Hu's memorial with tunic and bead necklace is above the gates here

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Location of the large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key

zones.name: Queen's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Run-down Stag Station sub-area within Fungal Wastes; connects to Fog Canyon
zones.note: Once a bustling hub in Hallownest's prime; bells and voices of bugs can still be heard

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.fingerprintHint: Adjacent to Fungal Wastes; connected via Queen's Station
zones.note: Whispering Root near Fog Canyon yields 20 Essence

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Access to Elder Hu's spirit fight; collect Essence; read Dream dialogue from corpses
abilities.note: Required to initiate the Elder Hu boss fight and to Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended (not required) to dodge Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack; enables alternate spell build strategy

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell used in alternate strategy to quickly defeat Elder Hu alongside Shade Cloak and a Spell build

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell used as alternative to Howling Wraiths in spell build strategy against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Dashmaster
abilities.note: Charm found as a Point of Interest in Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Spore Shroom
abilities.note: Charm found as a Point of Interest in Fungal Wastes

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage; fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail; drops 100 Essence. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Mantis Lords killed him after he attacked the Mantis Tribe in his Infected madness.

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Killed Elder Hu after he attacked them; referenced as background lore in this segment
